definitions.explanation: A humble expression for giving someone a gift or present. The speaker lowers themselves by using this word, making it appropriate when offering something to a superior, customer, or someone deserving respect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{粗品|そしな}→粗品：07470_soshina⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{進呈|しんてい}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We would like to present you with a small gift.

examples.japanese: ご⟦{来場|らいじょう}→来場：17703_raijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記念品|きねんひん}→記念品：03049_kinenhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{進呈|しんてい}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will present a commemorative gift to those who attend.

examples.japanese: ⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回答|かいとう}→回答：00142_kaitou⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、もれ⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{図書|としょ}→図書：03459_tosho⟧⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{進呈|しんてい}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We will present a book gift card to everyone who responds to the survey.

notes:
USAGE:
A humble (⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧) expression used by the giver. Very common in commercial and promotional contexts where a business gives something to customers. Not used when receiving a gift.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{記念品|きねんひん}→記念品：03049_kinenhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{進呈|しんてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to present a commemorative gift)
- ⟦{粗品|そしな}→粗品：07470_soshina⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{進呈|しんてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to present a small gift)
- もれ⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧{進呈|しんてい} (given to everyone without exception)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{贈呈|ぞうてい}→贈呈：16752_zoutei⟧: presentation; bestowal — more formal, used for awards and ceremonies
- ⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧: to give; to present — general term, less formal
- ⟦{差|さ}し{上|あ}げる→差し上げる：01597_sashiageru⟧: to give (humble) — spoken humble form, used in daily polite conversation
